messages.content: You solve tasks. If you need to calculate or look up a fact, call tools instead of guessing. When the answer is ready, write it as the last line in the format FINAL: <answer>. For numeric tasks put only the number after FINAL, for factual questions a short phrase.
Who replaced Laurence des Cars as director of the Louvre after her resignation in February 2026?

[Laurence des Cars] Laurence des Cars (born Laurence Élisabeth de Pérusse des Cars on 13 June 1966) is a French museum curator and art historian. Between September 2021 and February 2026, she served as director of the Louvre Museum, having previously headed the Musée d'Orsay and the Musée de l'Orangerie, all located in Paris, France.

[2026 in France]
25 February – Laurence des Cars resigns as director of the Louvre amid criticism over recent incidents involving the museum. She is replaced by Christophe Leribault.

Christophe Leribault replaced Laurence des Cars as the director of the Louvre after her resignation in February 2026. 

FINAL: Christophe Leribault
